Name: Mode
Description: Selects the filter response curve used to shape terrain detail by frequency (scale).

Flubs.Name: LowPass
Flubs.Description: Keeps large-scale forms and smooths out high-frequency detail.

Flubs.Name: HighPass
Flubs.Description: Keeps fine detail and removes broad, low-frequency forms.

Flubs.Name: LowShelf
Flubs.Description: Boosts or cuts low frequencies while leaving higher frequencies mostly unchanged.

Flubs.Name: HighShelf
Flubs.Description: Boosts or cuts high frequencies while leaving lower frequencies mostly unchanged.

Flubs.Name: BandPass
Flubs.Description: Keeps a band of mid frequencies and attenuates both low and high frequencies outside the band.

Flubs.Name: Notch
Flubs.Description: Removes a narrow band of frequencies while leaving the rest mostly unchanged.

Flubs.Name: Bell
Flubs.Description: Boosts or cuts a centered frequency band with a controllable bandwidth.

Name: Frequency
Description: The center/cutoff frequency of the filter (controls which detail scale is affected).

Name: Gain
Description: Amount of boost or cut applied (used by shelf and bell modes).

Name: Q
Description: Filter sharpness/bandwidth (higher Q = narrower, more selective band; lower Q = broader influence).

Name: Keep DC
Description: Preserves the overall baseline/average height (DC offset) so the filter affects detail without shifting the mean elevation.
